_comment: Repos with a production target. The deploy-watch routine polls each enabled repo's forge main; when the tip moved and its Forge CI status is success it runs the deploy-main Loom graph, which stages that exact OID and runs the repo's OWN deploy script with the same variables the retired launchd watchers gave it. `env` is copied into the deploy script's environment. `verify_command` runs after the deploy with DEPLOY_OID / DEPLOY_REPO set and must exit 0 (retried for up to 10 min). Disabled repos are listed so the retirement of their launchd agents is visible here, not only in launchd's override table. Every repo listed here moved to GitHub on 2026-09-29/30, so none can use this Forgejo-only watcher.

repos.verify_command: curl -fsS --max-time 20 https://thelastdb.com/llms.txt | grep -q 'LastDB' && curl -fsSI --max-time 20 https://thelastdb.com/ | grep -qi '^HTTP/[0-9.]* 200'
repos.notes: thelastdb.com via vercel promote (token lastsecrets://lastgit-vercel-token). The gate of record is GitHub EdgeVector/fold_db_website since 2026-09-30 (LastGit is retired, decision-2026-09-29-retire-lastgit-all-repos-to-github). deploy-watch is Forgejo-only by construction and cannot serve it, so this entry stays disabled. The deployer of record is the per-repo GitHub poller that reads the ci-required check run on GitHub main (com.edgevector.github-deploy-fold-db-website, installed by Tom); the old com.edgevector.lastgit-deploy-fold-db-website label is retired.

Exemem cloud pipeline. Production deploys use the LastSecrets-backed OBS_SENTRY_DSN locator at the deploy child boundary. The gate of record is GitHub EdgeVector/exemem-infra since 2026-09-30 (LastGit is retired). deploy-watch is Forgejo-only by construction and cannot serve it, so this entry stays disabled. The old com.edgevector.lastgit-deploy-exemem-infra label is retired; a production deploy stays a decision for Tom (sop-migrate-repo-to-github, exemem-infra section).

The old com.edgevector.lastgit-deploy-schema-infra and canary-ticker labels are retired (plists renamed .disabled-20260930); no deploy workflow is enabled on GitHub until Tom decides.

The deployer of record is the GitHub poller in .lastgit/deploy-run.sh that reads the ci-required check run on GitHub main (installed by Tom).
